notes:
Account summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B) with global customers; product team building a multi-modal chat agent for support and sales assist. Priorities: predictability for latency-sensitive chat flows, streaming start-of-response latency, and reliable tool-calling to internal APIs. Interested in Redwood hosted API to validate latency/SLOs, then move to Dedicated for committed throughput/cost predictability if POC meets acceptance criteria.

POC acceptance criteria (customer-specified):
- End-to-end streaming start latency (time-to-first-chunk) p95 <= 250ms for U.S.-region traffic.
- Sustained concurrency: 50 active chat sessions with 10 RPS average across tokens, no queueing spikes > 500ms.
- Tool-calling reliability: webhook/connector roundtrip success >= 99.5% under normal load; graceful fallback to cached answers on failures.
- Deterministic routing for premium tenants (routing by tier + fallback to smaller quantized variant if capacity constrained).

Conversation highlights:
- 2026-02-04 intro: Product lead "We need streaming to feel instant — can't have 600ms first chunk for sales demos." AE Marissa demoed Redwood streaming + tool-calling example.
- 2026-02-11 security: Infosec requested SOC2 evidence, SSO flow test, and details on KMS usage; asked about EU residency for a subset of customers.
- 2026-02-25 architecture call: SE Diego walked through canary + A/B rollout using Redwood Optimize and rollout policies; customer liked canary metrics tie to prompt/eval regressions.
- 2026-03-03 pricing chat: CFO wants committed capacity pricing scenarios (monthly vs annual) with burst lanes and overage cap.

Concerns flagged by EchoQuark:
- Cost sensitivity for high-traffic tenant tier; wants recommendations on batching/quantization that don't regress agent answers.
- Need to gate model/patch rollouts with prompt-set regression tests (QA must pass before canary expands).
- Legal needs clarification on retention controls and ability to route EU customer data to EU-hosted deployment.

Suggested Redwood playbook for POC:
1) 2-week hosted POC (US region) focused on latency SLOs + streaming demos; collect traces for p50/p95 token latencies.
2) Run parallel evals of quantized model variant to measure quality delta on core prompt set; produce A/B report.
3) Configure canary rollout for agent model using prompt-based regression gating (fail on >2% metric regression).
4) Present Dedicated capacity pricing scenarios tied to measured QPS and token/sec from the POC.
